dialogues.speaker: Night Warden War Notice
dialogues.text: "The dust has settled upon this Night Warden War. Glory evermore to Natlan!"

dialogues.speaker: Night Warden War Notice
dialogues.text: "Our warriors have obtained a great victory, heaping fresh wood upon the Sacred Flame!"

dialogues.speaker: Night Warden War Notice
dialogues.text: "Despite the great dangers to themselves, and indeed, to 'Utha{RUBY#[D]Resilience}biti' Kachina in specific..."

dialogues.speaker: Night Warden War Notice
dialogues.text: #"With the aid of warriors of the tribes, the outlander {NICKNAME}, and {M#his}{F#her} guide Paimon..."

dialogues.speaker: Night Warden War Notice
dialogues.text: "All were preserved from peril and returned victorious!"

dialogues.speaker: Night Warden War Notice
dialogues.text: "Let us give them our most passionate applause and wondrous benedictions! Let us revel in yet another moment of glory for Natlan!"
